facts.claim: OpenAI forecasts negative free cash flow of $278 billion over 2026 to 2030, per the Financial Times as relayed by Reuters.

facts.notes: Forecast, not a reported result; the same source says the $122bn raised in March is on track to be exhausted by 2028.

facts.claim: OpenAI forecasts spending about $856 billion on computing power and infrastructure by the end of 2030, its largest expense category.
quotes: OpenAI forecasts spending about $856 billion on computing power and infrastructure by the end of 2030, its largest expense category, the report said.
facts.notes: A spending forecast covering compute and infrastructure; other outlets give lower contractual totals, so treat as the forecast ceiling.

facts.claim: OpenAI expects revenue to rise from $36 billion this year to $350 billion in 2030, and a cumulative $840 billion through 2030.
quotes: The AI firm expects revenue to increase tenfold over the same period, rising from $36 billion this year to $350 billion in 2030, the FT said, adding that OpenAI anticipates generating a cumulative $840 billion in revenue through the end of the decade.
facts.notes: Forecast; the 2030 figure is $350bn.

facts.claim: OpenAI spent $3.7 billion in the first three months of 2026, on about $5.7 billion of revenue, as reported by The Information.
quotes: OpenAI spent $3.7 billion in the first three months of 2026.
Revenue came in at approximately $5.7 billion for Q1 2026, meaning OpenAI burned through roughly 65 cents for every dollar it brought in.
facts.notes: Cash burn per The Information via a crypto-news summary; revenue $5.7bn in the same quarter.

facts.claim: Anthropic said it had raised approximately $141 billion through June 2026 and held $112.4 billion in cash.

notes: Balance-sheet figures and P/E come from companiesmarketcap.com per-company pages, which convert to USD and date the latest report (June to September 2026 by company); the companies' own releases were not fetched, so line items beyond assets, cash, debt and equity (PP&E, goodwill, leases, liabilities) are not covered. The dated figures differ by company (see each period). Exchange-rate facts are the Fed H.10 rates for 30 Oct 2026, the latest day in the release of 2 Nov. Unverified and left out: OpenAI total capital raised (an aggregator says about $180bn including debt), OpenAI's $600bn compute target, Anthropic's $780-810bn commitments estimate (a social-media post). Micron's and Samsung's assets look high against 2025; they are as the source reports.
